## [1.4.0-dev.1](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/compare/v1.3.3...v1.4.0-dev.1) (2026-09-15)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Clear the lint errors the vendored piko code arrived with ([316e18d](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/316e18d7f1e77e909aca4b3e94c0a0ea5a5c7d65)), closes [Type#getTypeName](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/Type/issues/getTypeName)
* **Instagram:** Anchor the media model on json keys rather than call sites ([7c89099](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/7c8909969158979a47bdcf28a16840329f21d9bc))
* **Instagram:** Declare the folder picker activity so downloads can ask for a folder ([2b46dc8](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/2b46dc81289d4a52e1551092014256c39e957dfd))
* **Instagram:** Give the added menu options an ordinal that matches $VALUES ([ffdf25e](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/ffdf25e512bec3e1a4282a20c16315eb26f143f3))
* **Instagram:** Give the piko_* labels English text without a resource patch ([940ae54](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/940ae544ccadbfc2ae89b1096a60cae9acbc3e11))
* **Instagram:** Pick the image candidates getter by its json key ([2640ee2](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/2640ee23e2025acd4e38881ff12120e035221b10))
* **Instagram:** Read the post type key into the method that reads the field ([1dad50b](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/1dad50b99d695cb955f352dc2fb9395cfcef1c1e))
* **Instagram:** Resolve the universal id helper, and stop the story menu crashing ([0f97d90](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/0f97d90c4cab26db80a9fd5dd451589b55bbf314))
* **Instagram:** Set the patch-applied flags from the class initialiser ([1f9a7e1](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/1f9a7e1cc59a718b06c76eeb127dda6967a8783f))
* **Instagram:** Stop naming classes 446 moved out from under the extension ([73a715f](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/73a715f91f31ba7a00ea1eec2f32093be9fef2da))

### ✨ New Features

* **Instagram:** Add the download row through the app's own sheet builder ([769c2ee](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/769c2eec3be9c91f1e3e509391382ee38a4a1914))
* **Instagram:** Decode the user model, which the download dialog needs ([c484f4f](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/c484f4fcf828d0bf26f697f7c595e2deac921b39))
* **Instagram:** Download media for posts, reels and stories on 446 ([80bf600](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/80bf600c34cc3f4c3f7bdef7a95cd30746d6efe0))
* **Instagram:** Put the feed download action on Save, which the sheet will draw ([cdcc6a9](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/cdcc6a904c66a8113452a85e6e8a82e02b8bb82c))
* **Instagram:** Vendor piko's Download media, not yet working ([909737b](https://github.com/ahmedyarub/morphe-patches/commit/909737bb1e3e027569766a9d417c0c1f8a8a2950))
